basics.name: Jayden Dongwoo Lee
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher (AITA InnoCORE), KAIST
basics.summary: GNC researcher working on AI-based guidance and control, fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant control for eVTOL and multirotor platforms, and GNSS-denied navigation with quantum magnetometers. Ph.D. dissertation received the KAIST College of Engineering Outstanding Ph.D. Dissertation Award (2026).

work.name: KAIST — AITA InnoCORE Program, Dept. of Aerospace Engineering
work.summary: Lead researcher on AI-based fault-tolerant control and quantum-magnetometer-aided navigation (MagNav) for eVTOL and unmanned aerial systems (advisor: Prof. Hyochoong Bang).
highlights: Mentor graduate and undergraduate students on disturbance-observer design, data-driven system identification, and drone-based aeromagnetic surveys.
Coordinate flight-test campaigns integrating VN-200 INS, ZED-F9P RTK-GPS, and magnetometer payloads for GNSS-denied navigation.

work.name: AI Research Center, Hanyoung Nux Co., Ltd.
work.position: AI Research Engineer (concurrent with graduate studies)
highlights: Designed industrial temperature-controller algorithms combining classical PID tuning with data-driven adaptation.
Delivered productized control modules for the company's instrument line.
